extensionDescription: Translate email bodies in place: bilingual or translation-only, free Google/Microsoft translators and 20+ AI providers.
popupRetranslateHint: Translate this message again without cached translations
popupNotConnected: No message content available. Reopen the message and try again.
popupNothing: Nothing to translate: the message is already in the target language.
hintSameLanguage: The source language is the same as the target language, so nothing will be translated.
tiersEmpty: At least one tier needs a service.
labelAutoTranslate: Automatically translate messages not in the target language
popupShortcuts: Shortcuts: Alt+A translate, Alt+S switch display, Alt+R retranslate
uiLanguageHint: Applies to the popup, this settings page and the labels shown inside messages. The extension name, its description in the Add-ons Manager and the keyboard shortcut descriptions are read by Thunderbird itself and always follow Thunderbird's language.
tiersHint: Every paragraph goes to all tiers in use at the same time. The highest tier that has answered is shown: a lower tier as a provisional translation in italics, labelled with its tier, and the highest tier in use as the final translation. If the highest tier fails, the best lower translation stays, marked with the reason; a click retries the failed tier. A paragraph whose translation by the highest tier is already cached is not sent to the lower tiers.
hintPrecise: The AI service translates with the whole message as context, so names, terms and forms of address stay consistent. When the message does not fit into one request, one extra request first analyzes the whole message (summary, glossary, tone), and every request then carries this analysis. Costs are higher than in normal mode.
hintDictionaryProvider: Translates word by word with dictionaries stored on this computer; no text leaves Thunderbird. Download the language pairs under Dictionaries.
hintBergamot: Translates on this computer with the Bergamot models; no text leaves Thunderbird. The models for each language pair are installed separately.
hintThinking: Lets the model reason before it answers. Translation does not need it; with thinking off, requests are faster and cheaper. Only models that have a thinking mode are affected.
hintThinkingUnsupported: This provider does not support controlling thinking; the extension sends no thinking parameter.
hintKeyLocal: The key is stored only in this Thunderbird profile (storage.local) and is sent only to this service's endpoint.
hintAzureEndpoint: Full URL of the Translator translate method. The default is the global endpoint; a resource with a custom domain uses https://<name>.cognitiveservices.azure.com/translator/text/v3.0/translate.
hintAzureRegion: The region of your Translator resource, for example westeurope, as shown under Keys and Endpoint in the Azure portal. A regional or multi-service resource needs it.
hintOllama: Start Ollama with OLLAMA_ORIGINS=moz-extension://* so it accepts requests from Thunderbird.
hintDeeplx: If the endpoint contains {{apiKey}}, the token replaces it; otherwise it is sent as a Bearer token.
warnBaseUrlInvalid: This is not a valid URL. An endpoint starts with https:// (or http:// for a local service).
removeBlockedTier: The tier "$1" uses this service, so it cannot be removed. Choose another service or "Not used" for that tier first.
promptsHint: The AI tier uses the prompt of the current display mode, and the precise prompt while precise translation is on. {{to}} is replaced by the name of the target language. The source language and the batch format are added to every request.
labelPromptBilingual: Bilingual display: close to the original, sentence by sentence
labelPromptTranslationOnly: Translation-only display: fluent text that reads on its own
labelPromptPrecise: Precise translation: consistent terms and names across the whole message
labelLlmBatch: Merge paragraphs into one AI request
batchHint: Free services cap a request at 5000 characters and 100 paragraphs regardless of these values. A paragraph longer than one request allows is translated in pieces, cut at line breaks where possible, else at sentence boundaries. A request without an answer within the timeout is retried once; an AI request is not retried, and local models (Ollama, LM Studio) and models in thinking mode get three times the timeout.
stylePreviewOriginal: The quarterly report is attached. Please review it before Friday.
stylePreviewTranslation: Le rapport trimestriel est joint. Merci de le relire avant vendredi.
dictionaryHint: Language pairs for the dictionary tier, stored in this Thunderbird profile. Pairs without English go through English and need both packs, for example French → English and English → German.
dictionaryAttribution: Dictionary data adapted (extracted, filtered and trimmed) from Wiktionary (Wiktionary contributors; extracted by wiktextract, published by kaikki.org), $1; the English → Simplified Chinese pack adapted from ECDICT, Copyright (c) 2025 Linwei, $2 License. Each pack names its own source below.
dictIndexFailed: The list of dictionaries could not be loaded. $1
dictionaryStorageFailed: Could not save or read the dictionaries in the extension storage.
labelDictTag: Release tag of the dictionary packs (advanced)
bergamotHint: The Bergamot service translates on this computer with Mozilla's translation models, the models of Firefox Translations (MPL-2.0). Each direction is downloaded once on request, 13–48 MB, and takes about 200 MB of memory while it is loaded. Every model has English on one side, so other language pairs use two directions through English.
bergamotNeededAuto: The source language is detected automatically. Install $1, and for every other language you receive its direction into English.
bergamotNeededAutoEnglish: The source language is detected automatically. Install the direction into English of every language you receive.
bergamotLoading: Loading the list of offline models…
bergamotDeleteNeeded: The current source and target languages need this direction. Delete it anyway?
errDeeplxTokenMissing: $1: the endpoint contains {{apiKey}} but no access token is set
errEmptyAnswer: The model returned an empty answer
hintDictionaryDownload: Download the language pair on the settings page, under Dictionaries. Pairs without English need both packs through English.
errDictionaryUnsupported: No dictionary is available for the language $1
errChineseVariants: This service does not translate between Simplified and Traditional Chinese.
errDictionaryFormat: The dictionary file is damaged or has an unknown format
errDictionaryChecksum: $1: the downloaded file does not match its checksum
bergamotModelMissing: The offline translation model for $1 → $2 is not installed. Install these language pairs in the settings: $3
bergamotDetectFailed: Could not detect the language of the text. Choose the source language for offline translation.
bergamotRecordsFailed: Could not load the list of offline translation models from Mozilla.
bergamotDownloadFailed: Could not download the offline model file $1.
bergamotChecksumMismatch: The downloaded model file $1 is damaged (checksum mismatch). Try the installation again.
bergamotStorageFailed: Could not save or read the offline models in the extension storage.
bergamotEnginePaused: The offline translation engine did not answer twice in a row. Offline translation pauses for $1 s; try again afterwards.
errNetworkNoHost: $1: could not connect to the server
errDownloadStalled: $1: no data received for $2 s, download stopped
errUnreadableResponse: $1 returned a response that is not in the expected API format
hintAuth: The API key is invalid or lacks permission. Check the key and the account's access rights.
hintAzureAuth: The Azure Translator key or region is wrong. Use a key of a Translator or multi-service resource and enter the region shown under Keys and Endpoint in the Azure portal (empty only for a global resource). A 403 can also mean the free quota is used up.
hintEndpoint: The endpoint or the model name may be wrong. Check the API endpoint.
hintEndpointDiffers: The default endpoint of $1 is $2, but $3 is set.
hintWebHost: $1 is a website (console, documentation or chat), not an API endpoint.
hintHtmlResponse: The server returned a web page instead of an API response: the endpoint points to a website, not to the API.
hintNotApi: This endpoint may not be the API of this service. Check the API endpoint.
hintRateLimit: Too many requests, or the quota or balance is used up. Wait a moment or check the account's plan and balance.
hintServerError: Server error at the service. Try again later.
hintNetwork: Check the API endpoint, the network connection and the proxy settings.
hintTimeout: The service answered too slowly or not at all. Try again later, or raise the request timeout under Request batching in the settings.
hintModel: The model $1 may not exist or may not be available to this key. Check the model name.
hintModelGeneric: The model may not exist or may not be available to this key. Check the model name.
stepNotNeeded: Skipped: not needed with your choices
welcomeIntro: This guide sets up the extension step by step, with one decision per step. Every choice is saved at once, every step can be skipped, and everything can be changed later in the settings. If you leave the guide, it continues from the same step next time.
welcomeLanguageHint: With “Detect automatically”, each paragraph is translated from the language it is written in. A fixed source language suits mail that mostly arrives in one language: the services no longer have to guess the language, and the offline step can recommend exactly the downloads you need.
welcomeDisplayIntro: Choose how a translated message looks. You can switch at any time with Alt+S or in the popup.
welcomeBilingualHint: The translation appears under each original paragraph. Useful to check the original or to learn the language.
welcomeTranslationOnlyHint: The translation replaces the original paragraph and reads like a message written in your language.
welcomePreviewOriginal: Hi Anna, thanks for your quick reply.
welcomePreviewTranslation: Bonjour Anna, merci pour votre réponse rapide.
welcomeTiersIntro: The extension translates with up to three tiers at the same time. Every paragraph goes to all tiers in use; the fastest result appears first, and the highest tier in use replaces it with the final translation. Choose a service for each tier, or “Not used”. At least one tier needs a service.
welcomeSpeedMachine: One to two seconds per message
welcomeSpeedAi: A few seconds to a minute, depending on the model and the length of the message
welcomeQualityDictionary: Word by word, without grammar: shows what the paragraph is about
welcomeQualityAi: The most natural; keeps tone and context and follows your prompts
welcomePrivacyMachine: Google, Microsoft and DeepLX receive the text; Bergamot translates offline
welcomePrivacyAi: The AI provider receives the text; with local models (Ollama, LM Studio) it stays on your computer
welcomeCostDictionary: Free; a download of a few MB per language pair
welcomeCostMachine: Free; Bergamot downloads 13–48 MB per direction
welcomeCostAi: Billed per use to your API key; local models are free
welcomeTiersHint: Services that need data or configuration are set up in the next steps; steps that your choices do not need are skipped.
demoHint: A sample paragraph, translated the way the tiers you chose work together. It plays on this page and sends no request.
demoSource: Could we move tomorrow’s meeting to Thursday? I will send the new slides tonight.
demoDictionary: Könnten wir bewegen morgen Treffen zu Donnerstag? Ich senden die neu Folien heute Nacht.
demoMachine: Könnten wir das Treffen von morgen auf Donnerstag verschieben? Ich werde die neuen Folien heute Abend senden.
demoAi: Können wir das Meeting von morgen auf Donnerstag verlegen? Die neuen Folien schicke ich dir heute Abend.
spotlightDictionary: Tier 1 is the fastest: a rough word-by-word translation from dictionaries, offline.
spotlightMachine: Tier 2 is machine translation: free online services, or Bergamot offline.
spotlightAi: Tier 3 is AI translation: the best quality; most services charge for it.
spotlightAgain: Show the tour of the tiers again
welcomeOfflineIntro: Offline services download their data once. After that they translate without a network connection, and no text leaves Thunderbird. Each list shows every language; the languages of the first step, of the interface and of your system come first, and what they need is ticked. Tick what to download, or skip this step and download later in the settings.
welcomeMachineIntro: Online machine translation sends the paragraphs of a message to the service. Google Translate and Microsoft Translator work without an account; Microsoft can also use your own Azure Translator key. DeepLX needs the address of a DeepLX server. The connection test translates one sentence.
welcomeAiIntro: Choose an AI provider, enter its API key and, if you want, a model. The key is stored only in this Thunderbird profile. The connection test sends one short sentence.
welcomeAiRequests: Thinking mode and precise translation both make translation slower and more expensive. In thinking mode the model produces reasoning tokens in every request. Precise translation sends the neighbouring paragraphs as context and, for long messages, one extra analysis request. Translation works well without either.
welcomePromptsIntro: The AI tier uses one of three prompts: the bilingual prompt stays close to the original, the translation-only prompt writes fluent text, and the precise prompt keeps terms consistent across the message. A preset adds rules to one of them, such as a regional variety or a writing style. The prompt box shows the combined text, which you can still edit; “Restore built-in prompt” removes every addition.
welcomeFinishIntro: The extension is ready. To translate a message:
welcomeUseButton: Open a message and click the Thunderbird Translate button in the message header toolbar. The popup starts the translation, shows its progress and holds the most-used switches.
welcomeUseAltA: Alt+A translates the displayed message, or shows the original again.
welcomeUseAltS: Alt+S switches between bilingual and translation-only display.
welcomeTryHint: Translates a sample message on this page with your current settings, through the same pipeline as a real message.
presetsHint: A preset adds a block of rules at the end of one prompt. Applying the same preset again replaces its block; different presets add up.
presetDialectHint: Writes the translation in a regional variety of the target language. The list shows the varieties of the current target language.
presetKeepTermsHint: Translates normally and keeps the original in parentheses after difficult words and technical terms.
presetKeepTermsExample: Nous terminerons l’audit préalable (due diligence) avant de signer la lettre d’intention (term sheet).
presetExplainTermsHint: Translates normally and explains the difficult words of each paragraph in a short note at the end of the same paragraph.
presetExplainTermsExample: Nous terminerons l’audit préalable avant de signer la lettre d’intention. 〔Note : audit préalable : examen complet d’une entreprise avant une transaction ; lettre d’intention : document qui résume les conditions principales d’un investissement〕
presetStyleHint: Sets the register of the translation; the content stays the same.
presetStyleFormalExample: Nous finaliserons l’audit préalable avant la signature de la lettre d’intention.
presetStyleCasualExample: On boucle l’audit avant de signer la lettre d’intention.
presetStylePlainExample: D’abord, nous vérifions bien l’entreprise. Ensuite, nous signons le document avec les conditions principales.
presetStyleLiteraryExample: Avant d’apposer notre signature au bas de la lettre d’intention, nous aurons mené l’audit jusqu’à son terme.
noticeMissingHint: The other tiers translate these paragraphs as usual. Once the downloads are installed, the offline tiers translate them too.
noticeMute: Don't remind me for these languages
presetNoneHint: Adds no rules: the prompt keeps only its base text.
presetNoneExample: Applying it removes every rule block that a preset added to the chosen prompt. Text you wrote yourself stays.
presetRemoved: Removed the preset rules from the prompt “$1”.
errDictionaryNoPack: The dictionary release has no packs for $1.
offlineMissing: $1 lacks what the current languages need: $2.
offlineUnsupported: $1 does not support the current language pair.
commonAllInstalled: The common languages are all installed.
offlineAutoHint: The source language is detected automatically. Mail in another language is translated into English with “language → English” and from there with “English → target language”. The directions of your languages are ticked.
downloadNothingPicked: Tick the items to download first.
downloadFailed: $1 downloads failed; the list shows why.

tipShowOriginal: Removes the translations and shows the message as sent
tipProvisional: Provisional results come from a lower tier until replaced
tipBilingual: Shows the translation under each original paragraph
tipTranslationOnly: Replaces each paragraph with its translation
tipSourceLang: Language of the mail, or detected for each paragraph
tipTargetLang: Language that messages are translated into
tipTierDictionary: Instant word-by-word gloss from offline dictionaries
tipTierMachine: Full translation by Google, Microsoft, DeepLX or Bergamot
tipTierAi: Best quality; most AI services charge per use
tipPrecise: Gives the AI the whole message as context; costs more
tipAutoTranslate: Translates a message on opening if it is in another language
tipOpenOptions: Services, offline data, prompts, style and cache
tipOpenWelcome: Walks through the setup again, step by step
tipShortcuts: Change them under Manage Extension Shortcuts in Add-ons
tipOfflineDownload: Opens the download lists, filtered to what is missing
tipUiLanguage: Language of this extension's own text
tipDefaultMode: How translations appear in a message
tipClearMuted: Shows the muted notices about missing downloads again
tipProviderFilter: Lists only the services of one tier
tipProviderItem: Shows the settings of this service
tipGroupAvailable: Add one to offer it in the tier selectors
tipInUse: A tier uses this service; it cannot be removed
tipGetKey: Opens the provider's page for keys and documentation
tipLicenseText: Opens the full text of the license
tipBaseUrlDefault: Address of the API; empty uses the default
tipApiKey: Stored only in this profile; sent only to this service
tipShowKey: Shows or hides the key in the field
tipRestoreBaseUrl: Clears the field so the default endpoint is used
tipModel: Model ID; empty uses the default, the list suggests others
tipThinking: Lets the model reason first: slower and costlier
tipMicrosoftFree: Microsoft's free endpoint; no account or key
tipMicrosoftKey: Your Azure Translator resource and its key
tipRegion: Azure region of the resource; empty for a global one
tipTest: Sends one test sentence with the values on screen
tipAdd: Offers this service in the tier selectors
tipUse: Puts this service in its tier, replacing the current one
tipRemove: Hides it from the selectors; its settings are kept
tipFilter: Language names or pairs like ja>en, separated by commas
tipDictTag: GitHub release the packs come from; default dicts-v1
tipDictReload: Reads the list of packs of this release again
tipBergamotReload: Asks Mozilla for the current list of models
tipPreset: Ready-made rules to add to a prompt
tipPresetOption: The variety or register the rules ask for
tipPresetKind: The prompt that receives the rules
tipApplyPreset: Adds the rules to that prompt; Plain removes them
tipPrompt: Instructions for the AI; {{to}} becomes the target language
tipResetPrompt: Drops your edits and all preset rules from this prompt
tipBatchDelay: How long paragraphs gather before a request is sent
tipMaxChars: A request is sent before it would grow longer
tipMaxItems: A request is sent once it holds this many paragraphs
tipConcurrency: Requests that run at the same time per service
tipRetries: Repeats a failed request, waiting longer each time
tipTimeout: Time for a full answer; local and thinking models get 3×
tipLlmBatch: Several paragraphs per AI request; off sends one each
tipStylePreset: How a translation is set apart from the original
tipColor: Color of the border or the highlight
tipTextColor: Applies to every translation; default follows the mail
tipResetTextColor: Uses the color of the message text again
tipOpacity: Lower values make the translation fainter
tipFontScale: Size relative to the message text, 0.7 to 1.5
tipCacheEnabled: Reuses earlier translations without new requests
tipCacheMax: Beyond this, the least recently used entries go first
tipPickItem: Ticked items are fetched by Download selected
tipRouteDirect: Translates straight into the target language
tipRouteViaEnglish: Leads into English for the route through English
tipInstalled: Stored on this computer; works offline
tipDownloadItem: Downloads it once; then it works offline
tipUpdate: Downloads the newer version from Mozilla
tipDeleteAnyway: Deletes it although the current languages need it
tipWaiting: Starts when a download slot is free
tipCancelQueued: Takes it off the download queue
tipDownloadCommon: 8 common languages to and from English; asks first
tipExitGuide: Closes the guide; next time it resumes at this step
tipReplay: Plays the demo again; it sends no request
tipTourAgain: Explains the three tier selectors again
tipTourSkip: Ends the tour; the link under the demo restarts it
tipTourNext: Moves to the next tier selector
tipAiService: The AI provider that tier 3 uses
tipTryIt: Translates a sample here, as a real message would be
tipBack: Previous step; your choices stay saved
tipSkipStep: Goes to the next step; this one is optional
tipNext: Goes to the next step; choices are already saved
tipFinish: Closes the guide; it starts from the top next time
tipNoticeOpen: Opens the settings with the missing items listed
tipNoticeMute: No more notices for these language pairs
tipNoticeClose: Hides this notice for this message
tipRetryTier: Click to retry the tiers that failed
